messages:
lena_support: FYI customer (Acme Corp) says daily usage CSV exports have dates shifted by one day compared to Console when they use America/Los_Angeles timezone. Example CSV attached.

lena_support: ```csv
date,project_id,tokens
2026-03-10,acme-123,12456
2026-03-11,acme-123,3452
```

maria_support: Can you grab the export job id and account id?

lena_support: acct=acme-123, job=20260311-09, attached export file (partial).

jorge_eng: I can take a look. Which exporter service produced that file? Any recent deploys?

deploybot: Deployment success: exports-service @ digest abcdef on 2026-03-10T21:12Z :white_check_mark:

kevin_sre: My hunch: exports are being bucketed using UTC day boundaries while Console shows user's local TZ. We'll need to check date_trunc/AT TIME ZONE usage.

peter_prod: Saw a similar report last month but thought it was customer timezone confusion. If exports are UTC-only that's a UX bug.

lena_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) Console -> Usage -> set timezone to America/Los_Angeles
2) Click 'Export CSV' for March 10
3) Compare CSV rows to Console daily totals — rows show Mar 9/10 instead of 10/11

jorge_eng: Can you share raw export job manifest or the response from /exports/20260311-09/status? Also what's the user's org timezone setting (account-level)?

maria_support: Customer confirmed org_tz=America/Los_Angeles. Pasted status response snippet (sanitized).

jorge_eng: Reproduced locally: export pipeline runs aggregation with timestamp cast to UTC then truncates day. Fix: apply user TZ before date_trunc. Filing BUG INF-4723. Patch will change SQL from `date_trunc('day', ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')` to `date_trunc('day', (ts AT TIME ZONE :user_tz))` and add tests.

peter_prod: Can we offer a one-off regenerated CSV for the customer? This impacts billing visibility.

kevin_sre: I'll run a manual rerun with timezone override and share link. ETA 2 hours.

jorge_eng: Pushed small patch to exports-service branch and added unit test for America/Los_Angeles edge-case. Will merge after review.

lena_support: Customer requested corrected CSV plus short explanation. I'll follow up once Kevin shares the rerun link. Thanks everyone :pray:
